final_message:
Accented letters now keep their base letter, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including the previously failing accent test.

The bug was in the vendored `slugify`, which drops any character outside plain ASCII instead of mapping it to its base letter. I didn't touch `vendor/`. The fix is in `src/blog/slug.js`: the title is decomposed (NFD) and the combining accent marks are stripped before it reaches `slugify`. That is the only file changed, and nothing is committed.
